items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: But what I found now is you know guys like Benny and Pete Fountain and — I like their ideas the best. So what I’m doing is each day I’ll learn, just for my own enjoyment, a new solo of one of them.

ctx.x: And does the theory of jazz playing play a role in the way you play? That was a lot of “plays.” And by that I mean I remember you brought up Dan Barrett. And he had a funny thing to say about modes that a student had asked him about. I’m wondering if modes and the current jazz pedagogy has any role in what you do.

I guess my honest answer is I’m not sure. I just kind of play things that speak to me, and I’m not quite sure what’s going on right now as far as currently, like in jazz academia, or what current guys are playing. So I guess in that sense it really hasn’t influenced me too much. For me personally, what I’m doing right now is I’m trying to develop more of my own ideas. And I think we’re always trying to find ways to do that, to find our own voice. I remember — I got to meet Kenny Davern about a year before he…
You’re very thoughtful about — are you a man of faith? Yes. And how does it help you in your day to day dealings?
